Name: Curvy Shirts for base sprite
Author: onlyonechris
Description:
[size=4]*MAJOR UPDATE*
Curvy Clothes, Curvy Sleeves and Curvy Shoes are my first attempt at modding and I have learned a ton. I have finally learned enough to properly put all these mods into ONE mod which is much easier both for me and for users. However, as some people used this mod without my body, I am rolling this back to the last edit that didn't look super weird with base body and I don't plan to update further as all future changes will be housed in the new mod. 

Check out the new combined (for your pleasure) mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8199]*Curvy Girl*[/url].




*Final Update*
Rolled back to images that still fit on the base sprite (shirts). Pants never fit that well so pants have been removed. THIS IS INTENDED FOR BASE GAME SPRITE USEAGE, if you liked the Curvy sprite, please use  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8199]*Curvy Girl*[/url]﻿.
[/size]

This mod just edits the base game Shirts and Pants to better fit my curvy sprite. 

1. Shirt changes - Smaller stomach, bigger boobs. I can't stand the pot belly on the normal girl sprite shirts. Can be used on base game without weirdness. Option to show bra or topless when taking off shirt. Will look strange on "full sleeves" days and darker skin colors (see pictures of sleeve colors to see what I mean).

HOW TO USE -
Download and add to your mods folder.
If you want to be TOPLESS (nude top) when taking off a shirt, choose "NudeTop" option in config. Defaults to wearing a bra. [b]Don't pick both bra and nude.
[/b]
